name: ChapterHero - No Image Fallback
description: What a chapter with no hero photo falls back to: the centered header rather than the full-bleed band. The kicker follows it here, so a page without a photo still says which kind of page it is - chapter or community, forming or not. Before that, the fallback was the one surface where a visitor could not tell, which mattered most for exactly the new and thin entries least likely to have a photo yet.
